meta.title: BPMNscript
meta.description: A text language for executable BPMN 2.0 processes: how its compiler and importer work, and what the round trip on public models measured.
meta.lede: BPMN is the standard diagram notation for business processes, and engines such as Operaton run it. BPMNscript lets developers write these processes as code. I built it for my bachelor thesis at the University of Hamburg: a compiler that writes BPMN XML for Operaton, an importer that reads BPMN XML back into source, and a language server for the editor.
